cohort: 34 women who underwent fetoscopic neural tube defect repair and met Management of Myelomeningocele Study eligibility criteria
finding: In a cohort of women who underwent fetoscopic neural tube defect repair, trial of labor with low-dose oxytocin was associated with reassuring outcomes, with a 50% vaginal delivery rate and no cases of uterine rupture or dehiscence.
mod_finding: In a cohort of women who underwent fetoscopic neural tube defect repair, 50% were able to have a vaginal delivery, and there were no cases of uterine rupture or dehiscence.
gest_age:
Median gestational age at vaginal delivery: 38 1/7 weeks 
Median gestational age at cesarean delivery: 37 1/7 weeks
